segments.summary: W-074 establishes a strict remote/local authority boundary, explicit consumer and non-GUI/non-runtime scope, stale-index and local-substitution prohibitions, and observable acceptance intent. The adjacent repair addendum concretizes worktree validity states, conflict persistence authority, and command gates. Adversarial review finds unresolved identity canonicalization, SSH trust, receipt lifecycle, concurrency and freshness publication, network recovery, cross-owner interfaces, state precedence, persistence lifecycle, atomic command reauthorization, and executable runtime-oracle gaps.
